title: 第二十一章 佛道耶稣三修？笑不活了
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
一露脸，姜无念顿时“啧”了一声，“这不吴星河嘛？才几天，怎么就成这副鬼样子了，快让我看看嘴烂了没？”

    屏幕里，吴星河面如枯槁，对着主播号啕大哭：“大师救我！我被恶鬼缠上了，求您发发慈悲！”

    主播手握佛珠，装模作样嘴里念念有词：“我不入地狱，谁入地狱，施主联系助理往功德箱添点香火钱吧，贫道自会为你化解。”

    吴星河感激涕零挂了连线，不一会又重新连上。

    只见那主播换上一身紫色道袍，对着神像念叨不停，拜了三清又拜菩萨，桌上还摆着给死人祭祀用的东西，姜无念真是开了眼了。

    连直播间的粉丝都看不下去了，助理还在直播间趾高气昂地嚷嚷：“你们懂什么，这叫佛道双修！”

    主播更是大言不惭，补充道：“贫道是佛道耶稣三修，国际上的事情也可以找我。”

    姜无念再也绷不住了，笑得趴在桌上，肩膀直抖，眼泪都快出来了。

    就这种招摇撞骗的货色，也敢出来丢人现眼，真是败坏玄学圈的名声。

    傅烬川刚从外面回来，身上还带着微凉的湿气，一进门就看见她笑得上气不接下气。

    见他回来，姜无念连忙招了招手，眼睛眯笑着，“快过来快过来，给你看个好笑的，这个神棍哈哈哈哈哈哈……”

    傅烬川凑过去，姜无念指尖点着屏幕里面色枯槁的男人，抬眸冲他挑眉。

    “这就是前几天我直播遇上的那个，被厉鬼缠上精气都快被吸空了，当初死鸭子嘴硬不信我，现在倒急着到处找骗钱的神棍。”

    直播里，那穿着盗版道袍的主播装模作样捻着佛珠念了几句，随手挥了挥空无一物的袖子，擦着根本不存在的汗。

    “好了，你身上的厉鬼已经被我打散了，往后就能平安无事。”

    “真的吗？多谢大师！”吴星河在镜头前激动地浑身发抖，语无伦次。

    “我以后还能去Hot Mix吗？”

    傅烬川听到“Hot Mix”几个字，微微皱眉，目光落在屏幕上，侧头看向姜无念，声音低沉：“他说的那地方，你觉得有问题吗？”

    这家夜店背后有傅家的股份，林砚调查的时候就有线索断在里面，只怕是和之前的失踪案脱不了干系。

    抱着胳膊懒洋洋地靠在椅背上，姜无念瞥了眼直播里还在忽悠功德钱的假道士，轻哼一声：
content_en:
As soon as his face showed up, Jiang Wu Nian immediately let out a "tsk", "Isn't this Wu Xinghe? It's only been a few days, why are you looking like this? Come on, let me see if your mouth is rotten?"

    On the screen, Wu Xinghe, with a haggard face, cried out to the anchor: "Master, save me! I'm trapped by an evil spirit, please show mercy!"

    The anchor held a Buddhist bead in his hand and pretended to mutter: "If I don't go to hell, who will go to hell? Please contact the donor to add some incense money to the merit box, and the poor Taoist will resolve it for you."

    Wu Xinghe cried with gratitude and hung up the connection, and then reconnected after a while.

    Jiang Wunian's eyes were really opened when he saw the anchor put on a purple Taoist robe, chanting incessantly to the statue, worshiping the Three Pure Ones and the Bodhisattvas, and there were things on the table for sacrificial offerings to the dead.

    Even the fans in the live broadcast room couldn't stand it anymore. The assistant was still shouting arrogantly in the live broadcast room: "What do you know? This is called dual cultivation of Buddhism and Taoism!"

    The anchor was even more brazen and added: "I am a Buddhist, Taoist, and Jesus. You can also come to me for international matters."

    Jiang Wunian couldn't hold back any longer. He was laughing so much that he lay on the table, his shoulders were shaking, and he was about to burst into tears.

    Such a swindler dares to come out and embarrass himself, which really ruins the reputation of the metaphysics circle.

    Fu Jinchuan had just come back from outside, with a slightly cool dampness still on his body. As soon as he entered the door, he saw her laughing so hard that she was out of breath.

    Seeing him coming back, Jiang Wu Nian hurriedly waved, his eyes squinting and smiling, "Come here, come here, let me show you something funny, this magic stick hahahahahaha..."

    Fu Jinchuan leaned over, Jiang Wunian pointed his fingertips at the haggard man on the screen, raised his eyes and raised an eyebrow at him.

    "This is the guy I met during the live broadcast a few days ago. He was so entangled by the evil spirit that his energy was almost sucked out. At first, he was so stubborn that he didn't believe me. Now he is looking for the magician to cheat money."

    During the live broadcast, the anchor wearing a pirated Taoist robe pretended to twist his beads and recite a few words, then waved his empty sleeves and wiped away the non-existent sweat.

    "Okay, I have dispersed the evil spirit in you, and you will be safe from now on."

    "Really? Thank you, Master!" Wu Xinghe was trembling with excitement in front of the camera, speaking incoherently.

    "Can I still go to Hot Mix in the future?"

    When Fu Jinchuan heard the words "Hot Mix", he frowned slightly, his eyes fell on the screen, he looked sideways at Jiang Wunian, and said in a low voice: "Do you think there is a problem with what he said?"

    The Fu family has shares behind this nightclub. When Lin Yan was investigating, there were clues in it. I am afraid it is closely related to the previous disappearance case.

    Crossing his arms and leaning lazily on the back of the chair, Jiang Wunian glanced at the fake Taoist priest who was still cheating on merit money during the live broadcast, and hummed softly:
title_en: Chapter 21: The Three Cultivations of Buddhism, Taoism and Jesus? I can't live without laughing anymore
